high_level_description: This image is an advertisement for a t-shirt featuring a graphic design. The design on the t-shirt depicts a black cat sitting at a piano. The cat is playing the piano with its paws on the keys, and the piano is shown in a minimalist style with clean lines and a simple color palette of red, beige, and black. The background of the t-shirt is predominantly black, which makes the colorful graphic stand out prominently. The graphic itself has a modern, artistic feel, with bold colors and geometric shapes.
